reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: First and Final Dividends distribution of Rs 2.50 per share for Voting and Non-voting Shareholders, out of Dividends received from Subsidiary Company, on which AIT has been paid, subject to shareholder approval under Article 155. No further AIT is payable, and shareholder will receive the full amount of Dividend declared.
